verdict.rationale: Quo is a business phone and communications SaaS, so an official CLI is a fair question for this kind of product. The evidence documents a REST API, OpenAPI specs, a Try-it playground, an MCP server and Claude/ChatGPT connectors, but no official command-line tool. Those are adjacent capabilities and earn no credit toward a CLI.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can use an official CLI
